description: What it does Krea 2 Turbo is a browser-based AI image generator running the eight-step distilled branch of Krea 2, a 12B-parameter diffusion transformer trained from scratch toward photographic behaviour. A 1024px draft returns in roughly two seconds, and 2K follows shortly after. Key benefits - Fast text to image: eight sampling steps instead of dozens, so drafts can be judged by eye rather than from memory - Image to image refinement from a reference or a previous frame, inside the same worksp
